text:
ConocoPhillips ticked up slightly today as oil prices held steady around $90 per barrel, with U.S. crude at $89.62 and global oil at $92.14. The stock has bounced back from a dip on November 16th, recovering most of that day's losses as prices stabilized after a two-week decline.

Geopolitical tension in the Middle East—with Iran escalating threats as a third U.S. carrier arrived in the Persian Gulf—tends to support oil prices by creating supply uncertainty around a critical shipping chokepoint. Combined with heating oil prices up 59% from last winter, underlying demand for refined petroleum products remains elevated despite broader economic caution.
